column1: VedaVMS Maintainer Cookbook 📖
A quick recipe for maintainers who upload PDF documents and update the Google Sheet.
📌 Note: This cookbook covers the everyday workflow. For the complete system architecture, one-time setup, or server credentials, see MAINTAINER_GUIDE.md.
🍳 The 3-Step Recipe
Step 1: Upload PDF in Plesk  ──>  Step 2: Copy Link from Browser  ──>  Step 3: Paste in Google Sheet
Step 1: Upload the PDF File
1. Log into Plesk: https://103.69.196.157:8443
2. Go to Websites & Domains ➔ vedavms.in ➔ File Manager
3. Open httpdocs ➔ docs ➔ open relevant folder (e.g. TU, sanskrit, Shiva-Stuti, etc.)
4. Click the blue + (Upload) button and select your PDF file.
Step 2: Get the Link (Zero Typing)
1. Find your uploaded PDF in the Plesk file list.
2. Click the three-dots menu (...) on the right side of the row.
3. Click "Open in Browser" (the PDF opens in a new browser tab).
4. Click the browser address bar and copy the URL (Ctrl + C).
Example copied URL: https://vedavms.in/docs/sanskrit/JSV_Samhita.pdf

📝 Updating an Existing Document (New Version / Errata)
1. Upload the new PDF to Plesk and copy its URL (Steps 1 & 2 above).
2. In Google Sheets, find the existing row for that document.
3. Update PDF_URL with the new link, and update Version (e.g. V1.1) and Date.
4. If there is an errata sheet, paste its link into Corrections_URL.
💡 Quick Rules for Maintainers
1. Document Numbering is 100% Automatic!
- You do NOT need to type 1), 2), 3) in the title. The website automatically numbers main books in order.
- For sub-books belonging to the book above, prefix with A), B), etc. (e.g. A) Surya Namaskaram displays as 1A) Surya Namaskaram).
2. How to Temporarily Remove a Document
- NEVER delete the row. Simply change Status from "Active" to "Hidden".
- The website hides it and seamlessly renumbers remaining books starting from 1).
3. Valid Supersection / Language Names
- Use any of these 14 category names in the Supersection column:
- Languages: Sanskrit, Tamil, Malayalam, Kannada, Telugu, Latin (IAST)
- Special Editions: Baraha Source, English, TS Jatai, TS Ghanam, Kanva Samhita, Parayanam & References, Ghana Sandhi, Ghana Maala Pilot
4. Bulk Data Migration & CSV Export
- To export all documents into a fresh CSV: python generate_documents.py --offline --export-csv data/vedavms_documents.csv
- Import into Google Sheets via File ➔ Import ➔ Upload.
5. When Do Changes Go Live?
- From Google Sheets:
• Click "🚀 VedaVMS" ➔ "1. 🚀 Publish to Staging (new.vedavms.in)" to preview changes in 1–2 minutes (logs in cell J2).
• Click "🚀 VedaVMS" ➔ "2. 🌐 Push Staging to Production (vedavms.in)" after review to promote to live (logs in cell J3).
- From GitHub Actions: Go to Actions ➔ select Deploy to Staging or Deploy to Production ➔ click Run workflow.
- From CLI: Run python scripts/deploy_site.py --staging or --production (with instant rollback via --rollback).
6. Recent Updates Rolling 90-Day Window
- The Recent Updates feed automatically shows documents released in the last 90 days.
- Because VedaVMS is a static site, this rolling window is computed when the site is built & published. Deploying updates automatically refreshes the window for the current date.
